description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values for three different conditions across layers, with the threshold set to 1e-3. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and spans from 0 to 20, representing the layer index of the model. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8, indicating the proportion of output values below the specified threshold. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," which remains consistently low, starting near 0.01 and ending near 0.002; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," which begins at approximately 0.8, rapidly declines to around 0.1 by layer 5, then continues to decrease more gradually to approximately 0.02 by layer 20; and a green dashed line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," which starts near 0.8, drops to approximately 0.3 by layer 3, continues to decrease to around 0.02 by layer 10, and then remains relatively flat near 0.01 for the remainder of the layers.
